cohort: Infants aged < 6 months (n = 15,322) and 12-15 months (n = 3,243) seeking care from public sector health care providers
finding: While exclusive breastfeeding at 6 months and continued breastfeeding rates showed some improvement compared to 2015 data, they remain below desirable levels, with several factors identified as being associated with lower breastfeeding rates.
mod_finding: Delivery via C-section was independently associated with a lower frequency of exclusive breastfeeding in infants < 6 months old.
